description: This file defines the Http2HeaderBlock class, which implements a key-value map for storing SPDY/HTTP2 headers with insertion order preservation, using internal storage and linked hash map. It includes nested classes for header value fragments, iterators, and a proxy for header values.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock
classes.description: A class representing a key-value map for SPDY/HTTP2 headers, maintaining insertion order and providing methods for header manipulation.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::HeaderValue
classes.description: A nested class managing fragments of header values, allowing appending and size estimation.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing header entries, supporting forward iteration and dereferencing.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::ValueProxy
classes.description: A proxy class for accessing and modifying header values associated with a key.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides access to the value proxy for a given header key, allowing lookup and modification.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a header entry by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all headers and associated storage.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a header key-value pair.

methods.name: AppendValueOrAddHeader
methods.description: Appends a value to an existing header or adds a new header if not present.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of headers.
